ALPINE-CVE-2026-95692 (openssl 3.5.9-r0, fixed in 3.5.9-r1) is in the pinned golang:1.27.4-alpine image used only as the backend build stage; the CGO_ENABLED=0 static binary is copied into a scratch image that contains no OpenSSL. No golang Alpine digest ships 3.5.9-r1 yet. Maintainer decision 2026-11-18; review by 2026-11-25. Remove when the FROM digest includes openssl >= 3.5.9-r1.

Tracked in https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/58. ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 (zlib 1.3.2-r1) is in the pinned golang:1.27.4-alpine image used only as the backend build stage; the statically linked binary is copied into a scratch image that contains no zlib. No golang Alpine digest ships zlib 1.4-r0 yet, and the Debian builder carries 229 critical or high advisories. Remove when the FROM digest includes zlib >= 1.4-r0. Maintainer decision on PR #62 (2026-11-18), see docs/nox-temporary-exception.md.

Tracked in https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/58. ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 (zlib 1.3.2-r1) is in the pinned golang:1.27.4-alpine base image of the development image. The Dockerfile installs zlib>=1.4-r0 and fails the build if it is unavailable; Nox inventories the FROM image, not the built one. Remove when the FROM digest includes zlib >= 1.4-r0. Maintainer decision on PR #62 (2026-11-18), see docs/nox-temporary-exception.md.

Exception approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-17 (https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/45#issuecomment-6960376515); review by 2026-11-20. GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (ReDoS through repeated extglobs) affects picomatch <= 4.0.7 and no patched release exists. picomatch is a build- and dev-time dependency of vite, vitest, tinyglobby, fdir and @vue/language-core; it matches glob patterns from repository configuration, not request input, and is not part of the built frontend bundle. Reachability with attacker-controlled patterns is not established. This baseline records accepted interim risk and is not evidence the finding is fixed; remove it when a patched picomatch is available and the lockfile is updated.

Confirmed false positive, approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-17 (https://github.com/felixgeelhaar/ghostline/issues/66#issuecomment-6961483840); review by 2026-12-17. Nox intermittently reports AI-038 (embedding API key stored with vectors) at README.md:22 columns 5-58, but that line is the 11-character setup command `cd frontend` at every reported revision (the same fingerprint at 5bb582a and 7a72b8b), the README holds no key material, and the repository has no embedding or vector-store code. Only this fingerprint is baselined: any other AI-038 fingerprint stays unbaselined and is reported by Nox. The hosted gate currently blocks only net-new critical or high findings, so a new medium AI-038 finding is reported without failing the check. Remove this entry if Nox reports a different location for this fingerprint.

Deliberate: Ghostline keeps sessions, OAuth state, logout revocations and rate windows in process memory (docs/hosted-deployment.md, docs/cluster-deployment.md), so exactly one pod may run; a second replica would split sessions and rate limits. TestDeploymentKeepsTheSingleInstanceContract enforces replicas: 1. Remove when shared session storage exists. Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 on PR #107; review by 2026-12-22.
